name: Hanoi Opera House
kicker: The opera house at 1 Trang Tien
summary: See the building at 1 Trang Tien, south of the lake. Vietnam Tourism says it was refurbished in 1997 and is currently under renovation, and it says to check the website for admission. No ticket price and no hour were copied from a blog. Both are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The Hanoi Opera House from the square
gettingThere: Walk south from Hoan Kiem to 1 Trang Tien. The minutes are check on arrival.
hours: Check on arrival. Vietnam Tourism says the house is under renovation and to check the website.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. No door price was taken from the tourism page, because that page says to check the website.
